## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

This 1-fascicle text is a devotional-doctrinal exhortation by [裴休](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E8%A3%B4%E4%BC%91) Péi Xiū (797–870), the senior Tang lay Buddhist intellectual and prime minister, urging the cultivation of *bodhicitta* (the *mind of awakening*). Péi Xiū was the disciple of [宗密](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%AE%97%E5%AF%86) Zōngmì and a major lay-Buddhist patron of the late Tang; his religious writings — including this work, the prefaces to several of Zōngmì's books, and the *Xīn fǎ yào* 心法要 (the *Essential Dharma of the Mind*) — are among the most distinguished examples of late-Tang lay-Buddhist literature.

**Abstract**

The work is conventionally datable to [裴休](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E8%A3%B4%E4%BC%91) Péi Xiū's mature period of Buddhist activity, c. 845 – 870 CE. The bracket adopted here reflects this window. The doctrinal substance — the *quàn fā pútí xīn* "exhortation to generate *bodhicitta*" — is one of the standard themes of Mahāyāna devotional literature, and Péi Xiū's contribution is distinguished by its literary elegance and its integration of Chán-Huáyán synthesis themes drawn from his teacher Zōngmì.

The work is preserved in the Manji *Xù zàng jīng* (X1010) collection.
